given_when_then.given: A Store Partner has an active agreement with the Platform Operator
given_when_then.when: The system processes a financial transaction record for that agreement
given_when_then.then: The system archives the legally binding contractual details including commission rates and payout schedules alongside the financial transaction record

given_when_then.given: A financial transaction record contains item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and net settlement amounts
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to finalize the settlement status
given_when_then.then: The system links the record to verifiable evidence of delivery before finalizing the settlement status

given_when_then.given: A delivery proof is missing for a completed order
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to archive the financial transaction record
given_when_then.then: The system flags the record as incomplete and prevents final settlement

given_when_then.given: A deviation occurs from the standard process during the financial transaction
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to record the transaction
given_when_then.then: The system records the nature of the issue and the current resolution status alongside the financial transaction record

success_criteria: The system archives commission rates and payout schedules alongside the financial transaction record
The system prevents final settlement until verifiable evidence of delivery is provided
The system records the nature of the issue and current resolution status for any process deviation
